note_ko: 절벽 위 리조트 인피니티 풀. 장소 디테일 기준(docs/장소팩_작성기준.md)에 따라 작성. 한결 수영복 레퍼런스용. {s}/{S}=she/She, {p}/{P}=her/Her, {o}=her, {lit}=빛이 닿는 의상 부분.
setting_en: a long infinity pool on a cliff terrace above the coast
feature_en: a long rectangle of clear turquoise water whose far edge meets the open sea
a few tall palm trees and low white villa walls along the left side of the terrace
ground_en: a pale stone pool edge with a wet darker band along the water
smooth cream stone paving across the terrace
far_en: a dark rocky coastline curving away to the right above the sea
small islands far out on the horizon

해질녘.sky_en: a wide sky running from deep blue overhead into orange and pink at the horizon
해질녘.light_en: low orange sunlight comes from the camera's left, falling across {p} face and shoulders
해질녘.shadow_en: long soft shadows stretch across the stone toward the camera's right
해질녘.desc_ko: 해 지기 직전, 낮은 주황빛 해가 카메라 왼쪽에서 비춤

맑은 낮.sky_en: a clear deep-blue sky with a few thin white clouds
맑은 낮.light_en: bright white sunlight comes from above and to the camera's left, falling across {p} face and shoulders
맑은 낮.shadow_en: short sharp shadows pool under {o} on the stone toward the camera's right
맑은 낮.desc_ko: 맑은 한낮, 높은 흰 해가 카메라 왼쪽 위에서 비춤

풀 가장자리에 서기.pose_en: stands barefoot on the stone edge of the pool with {p} weight on {p} left leg and {p} body turned slightly toward the right side of the frame
풀 가장자리에 서기.moment_en: {s} turns {p} head toward the camera with a gentle smile
풀 가장자리에 서기.desc_ko: 풀 가장자리에 서서 몸은 오른쪽으로, 고개는 카메라 쪽으로

수평선 보다 돌아보기.pose_en: stands at the pool edge facing the horizon with one hand resting on {p} other forearm
수평선 보다 돌아보기.moment_en: {s} looks back toward the camera over {p} shoulder
수평선 보다 돌아보기.desc_ko: 수평선을 보다 어깨 너머로 카메라를 돌아봄

천천히 걷기.pose_en: walks slowly barefoot along the pool edge toward the camera
천천히 걷기.moment_en: {s} smiles gently and looks toward the camera

물속에서 가장자리에 기대기.pose_en: stands waist-deep in the pool with {p} back against the far edge and {p} elbows resting on the stone behind {o}
물속에서 가장자리에 기대기.moment_en: {s} tilts {p} head toward the camera as a few water droplets run down {p} shoulders
물속에서 가장자리에 기대기.desc_ko: 허리까지 물에 들어가 풀 가장자리에 팔꿈치를 걸치고 기대어 카메라를 봄

camera.전신: Full-length shot from eye level with a 35mm lens, the frame running from above {p} head to below {p} bare feet, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the sea and the sky softly out of focus
camera.무릎 위: Medium-long shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to just above the knees, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the sea and the sky softly out of focus
camera.허리 위: Medium shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to {p} waist, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the sea and the sky softly out of focus

ground_contact_en: {P} bare feet rest on the pale stone edge of the pool
style_en: natural lifestyle photography with fine film grain and realistic skin texture

해질녘: the water is a clear turquoise that meets the sea at a straight line along the far edge
the palm trees are tall and dark green against the orange sky
the stone is cream with a darker wet band along the pool
맑은 낮: the water is a clear turquoise that meets the deep-blue sea at a straight line
the palm trees are tall and bright green
the stone is cream with a darker wet band along the pool

position_en: {S} is centered in the frame, with the pool and the open sea spreading out behind {o}
